title: Hong Kong
cardCompassMisprint: no-anchor (board map sticker Door 56 shows a port anchor; board is authoritative)
sideASummary: Player deck back. Dark blue sunburst around a haven on the water. No text and no printed code.
sideBSummary: Hong Kong, red Player card. Coordinates 22°16'32"N 114°8'38"E. The compass has no anchor, so the city is not a port. One covered SEARCH box fills the map. The city name and coordinates repeat upside down along the bottom. Printed code P3-12b.

searchBoxes.effectSummary: Companion Structural Engineer. While this card is in your hand, Build Shelter may discard a City card of any color, including this one.

states.summary: Same Player back. The SEARCH box is scratched. Companion Structural Engineer. While this card is in your hand, Build Shelter may discard a City card of any color, including this one.

rules: Red Player card for Hong Kong. Not a port: the compass has no anchor.
One SEARCH box. State 2 is that box scratched. Side A stays the Player deck back.
The scratch reveals Companion Structural Engineer. When you take the Build Shelter action, you may discard a City card of any color, including this card, if this card is in your hand.
The companion is not played and removed. It works while the card stays in hand. The word is "may," so a matching-color discard is still allowed.
notes: Card id 10711. State 2 card id 10726. One copy.
Coordinates 22°16'32"N 114°8'38"E. Printed code P3-12b stays on the scratched face.
Goes to the reserve when the package is opened.
No door number is printed in the box.
